Ms. West's family has been significantly impacted by her murder
rationale_highlights: Mr. Gladue is an Indigenous man whose background of early substance abuse is all too prevalent in the Indigenous persons coming before the courts
the recommended parole ineligibility period appropriately balances the aggravating and mitigating factors in this case
